rationale: M49 #762 + W2 (#769) (vue-element-admin MarkdownEditor/index.vue). #762 pinned member calls inside Options-API prop-default() factory bodies with a SINGLE factory — assertions that pass with or without the sibling-object collision — and closed as 'verified already-fixed' while the corpus file stayed broken.
